title: OAuth client secret rotation: reported behavior #201
content: OAuth client secret rotation: reported behavior #201. Rotate the replacement secret in the AcmeCloud console, deploy it to every worker, then revoke the old secret. A worker using a cached old secret receives HTTP 401 until its credential cache is refreshed. The JavaScript SDK 4.2.1 fixes a cache invalidation defect present in 4.2.0. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: oauth rotation 401 secret credential cache.

title: API access token lifetime: reported behavior #202
content: API access token lifetime: reported behavior #202. API access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Refresh tokens can obtain a new access token without asking the user to sign in again. Check the token expiry claim and clock skew before retrying a 401 response. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: token expiry refresh 401.

title: Okta SSO configuration: reported behavior #203
content: Okta SSO configuration: reported behavior #203. Create a SAML application in Okta, copy the entity ID and ACS URL from AcmeCloud, then upload the Okta signing certificate. Assign the Okta group to the application and map email to NameID. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: okta saml sso configuration.

title: SSO role mapping: reported behavior #204
content: SSO role mapping: reported behavior #204. Standard users need both an Okta application assignment and an AcmeCloud role mapping. If admins can sign in but standard users cannot, inspect the group claim and default role policy. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: sso standard users role mapping.

title: Webhook signature verification: reported behavior #205
content: Webhook signature verification: reported behavior #205. Compute HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body using the endpoint signing secret. Compare the result with the X-Acme-Signature header using a constant-time comparison. Do not parse and reserialize JSON before verification. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: webhook signature hmac raw body.

title: Multiple webhook endpoints: reported behavior #206
content: Multiple webhook endpoints: reported behavior #206. An organization can register up to ten webhook endpoints. Each endpoint has its own signing secret, event subscriptions, and retry policy. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: multiple webhook endpoints.

title: API rate limits: reported behavior #207
content: API rate limits: reported behavior #207. The standard API limit is 600 requests per minute per organization. HTTP 429 responses include Retry-After; use exponential backoff with jitter and avoid immediate retries. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: rate limit 429 retry after.

title: API v2 to v3 migration: reported behavior #208
content: API v2 to v3 migration: reported behavior #208. API v3 uses cursor pagination, renames the accounts endpoint to organizations, and requires the 2026-04 API version header. Migrate in a staging environment before changing production traffic. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: api v2 v3 migration version.

title: JavaScript SDK token refresh: reported behavior #209
content: JavaScript SDK token refresh: reported behavior #209. The JavaScript SDK refreshes access tokens automatically when a refresh token is configured. Version 4.2.0 may retain an old client secret after rotation; upgrade to 4.2.1 and restart long-lived workers. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: javascript sdk refresh token 4.2.

title: Invoice reconciliation: reported behavior #210
content: Invoice reconciliation: reported behavior #210. Invoices are generated on the first day of the month. Export the usage report and match organization ID and billing period against invoice line items. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: billing invoice usage.

title: Connector synchronization: reported behavior #211
content: Connector synchronization: reported behavior #211. The AcmeCloud connector synchronizes changed records every 15 minutes. A failed sync can be retried from the integration status page after correcting credentials. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: integration connector sync.

title: Authentication flow version: reported behavior #212
content: Authentication flow version: reported behavior #212. The new OAuth authentication flow was introduced in API version 2026-04. Clients on earlier versions continue to use the legacy token endpoint until migrated. Engineering reproduced the reported behavior and linked the mitigation to the maintained documentation. Context: authentication flow api version.
